callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a valid directory path
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized from the given project directory, or None if initialization fails (e.g., CodeGraph binary not available, index build failed).

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_functions_by_file
callees.pre_condition: The CodeGraphExtractor instance is valid and successfully initialized; language is a recognized language key; proj_dir is the project directory path
callees.post_condition: Returns a dictionary mapping each absolute file path to a list of (func_name, body_text) tuples for all functions extracted from files of the specified language within proj_dir.
